agentPurpose: Canonical balance data for the farm-game runtime and simulation scripts. Agents should modify this file first, run npm run sim:balance, then update Obsidian balance notes with findings.

goals.fiveMinutes: Let engaged players unlock corn/tomato and first expansion.
goals.thirtyMinutes: Keep premium crops as longer-term goals.
goals.dayOne: Let active players reach greenhouse/orchard goals, not legendary crops.
goals.weekOne: Use areas, collection, automation, and prestige to extend the product lifecycle.

offlineIncome.agentPurpose: Pre-prestige (active-farm) offline income. The idle-genre promise — earning while away — previously applied only to post-prestige chain farms, so most early/mid players accrued nothing offline. While away, each currently-growing plot accrues a fraction (efficiencyRatio) of its crop's netProfitPerHour, capped to capMs so a long absence can't snowball. Tied to actually-planted plots (not a hypothetical best-crop-on-all-plots estimate) so an empty or under-invested farm earns nothing and early balance isn't trivialized. capMs mirrors regions.chain.offlineCapMs (24h) so a once-daily player loses nothing. NOTE: this active-farm cap is a fixed constant (OFFLINE_INCOME_CAP_MS) independent of the offline_cap prestige skill, which only extends CHAIN farm caps — so tuning capMs here has no interaction with that skill. efficiencyRatio tuned 0.4→0.45 (#273) to strengthen the D1/D7 return incentive (idle-genre promise) while keeping 0.05 headroom below the 0.5 domination ceiling enforced by check-balance §offlineIncome; because offline gold over a window ≤ cap equals exactly efficiencyRatio × the same-window active-play gold (stage-independent), any ratio < 1 keeps offline from dominating active play. capMs held at 24h: extending it would let multi-day absences snowball and erode the daily-return cadence.

resetOffset.agentPurpose: Daily/weekly reset boundary offset (#251). All calendar-day resets (오늘의 작물·일일/주간 미션·룰렛·주말 축제·광고 일일 한도) previously rolled over at UTC 00:00 = KST 09:00 (commute/school time). offsetMs shifts every boundary via the shared getResetDayIndex(now, offsetMs) helper so it lands in a low-activity local window instead. Default 68400000 = 19h: KST(UTC+9) 04:00 reset (UTC 19:00), so the boundary falls in the dead of night and Friday/Sunday evening prime time sits fully inside the day. Must be in [0, 86400000). Live-ops/per-market tunable here.

weather.agentPurpose: Save-free daily ambient weather. A reset-day hash selects one weighted type; sell/speed bonuses are global, lightweight, and multiplicative with the existing crop modifier stack. Clear days are neutral. Precipitation is presentation metadata only and can be suppressed by the ambient-effects setting without changing gameplay.

ads.agentPurpose: Rewarded-ad frequency gates. Each rewarded ad (growthAd, harvestBonusAd, plotDiscountAd, offlineBonusAd, wheelBonusAd) is bounded by a per-day limit (...DailyLimit) and a cooldown (...CooldownMs) that throttles rapid re-watching within a day; rewardedGold instead uses a sliding-window model (rewardedGoldWindowMs / rewardedGoldMaxUsesPerWindow / rewardedGoldDailyLimit). plotDiscountAdCooldownMs and wheelBonusAdCooldownMs are intentionally 0 because their daily limits are 1 - the once-per-day cap is already the effective gate. offlineBonusAd also has a daily limit of 1, but keeps a 6-hour cooldown to prevent back-to-back claims across the 04:00 reset boundary and to match the return-interstitial cadence. Invariant enforced by scripts/check-balance.mjs: any rewarded ad whose daily limit is >= 2 must have cooldown > 0, otherwise the same-day limit could be spent back-to-back and the frequency gate is meaningless.

rewardedGoldScaling.agentPurpose: Rewarded-gold payout scale. The payout starts at nextGoalRatio of the next area unlock cost (a progression-relative floor), but that floor alone made one ad worth less than a few seconds of active play from the mid game on. productivityMinutes converts the player's own offline rate (planted plots only, same efficiencyRatio as offlineIncome) into an equivalent payout so the reward tracks what the farm actually earns. nextGoalCapRatio bounds the result against the same goal so a fast-cycling early farm cannot mint past the progression curve: at 0.25 a full day of rewarded ads (rewardedGoldDailyLimit) is worth at most one area unlock.

dailyBonus.agentPurpose: Daily login bonus scaling. The daily bonus is a fraction of the progression-scaled rewarded-gold (ad) payout per streak tier, so it grows with the player's next goal while always staying below the ad reward (max ratio < 1) to preserve the ad incentive. Streak structure: 3 daily tiers (day 1 / day 2 / day 3+). On top of the daily bonus, a weekly milestone pays an extra reward every `weeklyMilestone.everyDays`-th consecutive day (day 7, 14, 21, ...) as a loyalty reward for long-term retention; it uses the same progression-scaled ad reward times `weeklyMilestone.adRewardRatio`. The milestone is intentionally a multiple of one ad reward, but it is earned only once per weekly streak (not a per-claim ad substitute), so the ad incentive stays intact.

wheel.agentPurpose: Daily fortune wheel. One free spin per shared reset day, followed by at most ads.wheelBonusAdDailyLimit rewarded-ad bonus spins after the free spin is consumed (#298). Free and bonus spins use the exact same slot catalog and reward calculation. Slots carry a reward type: gold (default when the field is absent — legacy data keeps working), rp (research points = floor(progression-scaled rewarded-gold(ad) payout * research.donationRpRate * rpRatio)), or harvest_boost (extends the same timed harvest boost the rewarded ad grants, ads.harvestBonusBoostDurationMs, stacking by extension). Gold slots award floor(ad payout * goldRatio), so every reward type scales with the player's next goal and stays meaningful late-game. Slots are weighted (probability = weight / sum of weights); the jackpot is the rare high-multiplier slot. Reward slots/weights/multipliers/types are data-driven here so live-ops can tune the wheel without code changes (validated by check:balance).

mastery.agentPurpose: Crop mastery ranks. Cumulative harvest counts per crop reach tier-based thresholds and grant permanent per-crop sell/speed bonuses. Thresholds are indexed by crop tier so slow late-game crops rank up in fewer harvests.

mutations.agentPurpose: Rare harvest mutations. Each kind unlocks at a minimum mastery rank, gains chance per rank above it, and multiplies the final sale price. Discoveries are recorded per crop in the collection. firstDiscoveryPityHarvests caps only the first discovery after rank unlock; repeat drops keep their base chance.

collection.agentPurpose: Crop collection (도감) completion rewards. One-time gold payouts per area and for full completion. Roughly half the next area unlock cost for progression areas; tune via sim before shipping.

landmark.agentPurpose: 프레스티지 이후 열리는 5단계 메타 골드 싱크. 각 프레스티지 레벨은 같은 번호의 랜드마크 프로젝트 1개를 해금하며, 단계별 골드는 해당 티어의 졸업 비용에 비례한다. 5단계 총 골드는 정확히 졸업 비용의 72%가 되도록 런타임에서 마지막 단계를 보정한다. 작물 재고·동물 산출물·축제 납품 포인트도 함께 소비하지만 외형 진행 외 골드/판매/성장 배율 보상은 제공하지 않는다.

regions.agentPurpose: Prestige (farm chain) data. Graduating requires the legend_field collection plus gold (costBase * costGrowth^level). The old farm becomes a chain farm paying incomeRatio of its snapshot productivity. Crop sell AND cost scale by scalePerLevel^level (ROI-preserving inflation); archetypes vary growth time vs sale price. chain.offlineCapMs is the base offline accrual window (24h) so a once-daily player loses no chain income next to multi-day crops; the offline_cap prestige skill extends it (+4h/level, up to 40h).

research.agentPurpose: Research points (RP) come from donating harvests instead of selling them (rate vs final sale value). One-time nodes unlock automation/breeding; six repeatable scale studies provide an endless late-game RP sink. Repeatable costs grow geometrically and their positive effects feed the live economy paths. craft_studies/cooking_studies shorten the workshop and cooking-pot timers (timer = base / (1 + effect sum)); craft_studies is capped at growth_studies' per-level rate so the workshop can never outpace crop growth per RP spent, and craft output takes no profit multiplier at all.

breeding.agentPurpose: Crossbreeding recipes. Hybrid stats follow cost=(parents cost sum)*1.5, sell=(parents sell sum)*1.8, growTime=max(parents)*0.8, tier 10. Exception: the four low-tier-parent first-tier recipes (crystalberry/sun_grape/royal_potato/frost_blueberry) are floored above the pure parent-sum, because their tier 3~4 parents would otherwise yield outputs worth a fraction of the orchard-tier crops the player has already passed when unlocking hybrid_greenhouse (gold 5M + RP). Their cost/sell are re-derived so netProfitPerHour sits near the TOP of the [orchard-best, greenhouse-best] band (~3.3M/h, ROI 2.5): strictly better than the contemporaneous greenhouse crops the player can otherwise grow (pineapple~avocado, 2.1~2.4M/h) so the breeding_lab RP + 5M gold unlock is clearly worth it (#285), while still sitting just below greenhouse-best (cactus 3.4M/h) and mystic+ crops so they don't overtake normal-area progression. growTime stays parent-derived. Both parents must be discovered; advanced recipes need the breeding_advanced node.

achievements.agentPurpose: Endless milestone tracks. Tier N threshold = base * growth^(N-1); every claimed tier pays prestige stars. Titles unlock when the referenced track tier is claimed. A track's progress value comes from its `source`: `lifetime` (default) reads the cumulative stat named by `stat`; `collection` counts crop species discovered (mirrors the collection screen); `dailyStreak` reads the current daily-attendance streak. Derived sources reuse already-tracked state so no new persistent field is added.

weeklyEvent.agentPurpose: Weekend crop festival tuning. sellMultiplier is the legacy/default sale bonus (kept for back-compat). weekendLengthDays is how many days (from Friday, UTC) the festival window stays live. types is the event-type roster: each weekend rotates BOTH a featured area (date hash, unchanged) AND an event type (independent date hash) drawn by weight. axis='sell' boosts sale price, axis='speed' boosts growth speed, and axis='mutation' boosts mutation chance for the featured area. multiplier(>=1) is the type's bonus, weight(positive int) its draw odds. Tune strength/duration/roster here for live ops / A-B without code changes.

combo.agentPurpose: Harvest combo pacing. windowMs is how long after a manual harvest the next one still extends the streak; greatThreshold/legendaryThreshold gate the tier escalation (icon/color/audio). Invariant: greatThreshold < legendaryThreshold. Tune here so combo pacing is data-driven rather than hardcoded in the UI.

cropOfTheDay.agentPurpose: Crop of the day (today's featured crop). multiplier is the sell-price bonus applied when selling the featured crop for the current UTC day (the featured crop itself rotates via a deterministic date hash, unchanged). Data-driven here so live-ops can tune the featured-crop incentive without code changes, matching the other sell multipliers (weeklyEvent.sellMultiplier, mastery).

fertilizer.agentPurpose: 골드 소비 비료(즉시 성장 촉진) 튜닝. 성장 중인 밭에 골드를 지불해 남은 성장을 즉시 완료하는 능동 진행 가속 + 잉여 골드 싱크. 비용은 '남은 성장 시간(wall-clock) 동안 그 작물이 벌어들일 net 골드 가치'(getCropEconomyEstimate 기반)에 costMultiplier를 곱하고 올림해 결정적으로 산정하며 최소 minCost 골드를 보장한다. costMultiplier>1 불변식(check-balance가 작물별로 '비료 비용 > 단축 시간 골드 가치' 검증)이 순 진행 이득을 없애 광고 성장 스킵 인센티브·진행 곡선을 무너뜨리지 않는 순수 편의/골드 싱크로 만든다. 실계수는 여기서 튠한다.

growthStage.agentPurpose: Crop growth-stage visualization tuning. thresholds are the inclusive lower-bound growth ratios (0..1) at which a crop switches visual stage: sprout → sapling → budding → mature. nearlyReadyRatio is the ratio at/after which a still-growing crop shows the 'almost ready' cue. These shape how quickly a crop looks like it's progressing, so they live in the data layer. Invariant (validated on load): sapling < budding < mature.

missions.agentPurpose: Daily mission rotation. Deterministic missions drive active play across crops, animals, workshop, breeding, and gold sinks. Targets rotate per day via a date hash; the featured area is drawn from the player's unlocked areas. collect_produce/craft_complete/breed are hidden until their system is unlocked, while spend_gold is available from the starter crop loop. Stateless except for progress/claim tracking in GameState.dailyMissionState (meta layer, survives prestige). Rewards scale with progression like dailyBonus/wheel: reward = max(rewardGoldMin, floor(adRewardGold * adRewardRatio)) where adRewardGold (getRewardedGoldAmount) is injected by callers. Daily adRewardRatio stays < 1 so a mission never beats the rewarded ad once scaling kicks in. Progress is recorded on canonical pure event paths. Tune targets/ratios/floors here.

weekly.agentPurpose: Weekly mission track layered on top of daily goals, giving a multi-day horizon across crops, animals, workshop, breeding, and gold sinks. Boundary is UTC Monday midnight (see getMissionWeekKey). Targets are fixed per slot; the harvest_area featured area rotates weekly via a week-key hash. Gated deep-system goals use the same stable unlock policy as daily missions. Progress reuses canonical action paths and rewards scale like daily slots, with adRewardRatio intentionally >= 1 and capped at 5. Tune targets/ratios/floors here.

decorations.agentPurpose: Late-game gold sink + self-expression. Cosmetic-only farm decorations bought with gold; ownership lives in the meta layer (placedDecorations) and survives prestige. Prices climb so they soak up surplus gold once expansion/upgrades are exhausted: the catalog now spans every progression band (early 1.2k~35k, then one 'pleasant splurge' per area era — well~rainbow_fountain sit at roughly 1~35% of the next area unlock cost so they never gate progression but always give surplus gold somewhere to go). The top three (observatory/aurora_arch/celestial_palace, 150B~6T) extend the ladder into the prestige/chain-farm era: past legend_field (18B unlock) the only remaining gold destination is graduation (costBase 100B, ×6 per level → 600B/3.6T/21.6T…). They step at a ×6~7.5 cadence matching that ×6 graduation growth (so the sink ladder stays continuous, no dead band), each landing at ~25~28% of a successive graduation tier — squarely in the 1~35% 'pleasant splurge per era' rule — to give the longest-lived prestige cohort's surplus gold (tens of billions to trillions) somewhere to go. Keep items sorted by ascending price. Add new items here (key/icon/price); localized names live in i18n/labels.ts.

animals.agentPurpose: Supplementary re-visit loop with a cadence distinct from crops (feed → deterministic timer → collect produce → sell). A gentle, always-something-to-do trickle, NOT a primary income source: each animal's produce net/h ((producePrice - feedCost) / produceTimerMs) is kept well below the cheapest crop's net/h so it never dominates active crop farming (enforced by scripts/check-balance.mjs §animals). purchaseCost is a one-time gold sink; ownership + in-progress feeding live in the meta layer (GameState.animals) and survive prestige. Timers are deterministic (fedAt + produceTimerMs), no rng. The premium tier (goat/alpaca/turkey/peacock, #299) extends the roster past bee (32k) into the orchard+ gold band (60k~480k purchaseCost) so late-game players still have a new coop to build; their produce net/h (3000~6000) climbs above the early animals for a sense of upgrade but stays strictly below the cheapest crop's net/h (carrot ~7200) as §animals requires. Keep kinds sorted by ascending purchaseCost. Add kinds here (key/icon + costs/timer/price); localized names/descriptions live in i18n/labels.ts.

production.agentPurpose: Crop-processing workshop (#250): a calculated, planning-flavored gold sink distinct from active farming. Every harvest deposits one crop unit into the meta-layer inventory (GameState.production.inventory) as a byproduct; the workshop consumes stockpiled crops into higher-value goods (deterministic timer, no rng). Each recipe's sellPrice must exceed the raw input sell-sum (value-add multiple in [1.2, 4]), AND its realized net/h (sellPrice / timerMs, since stockpiled inputs are a free harvest byproduct) is kept below the cheapest crop's net/h (carrot, ~7200/h) so crafting never dominates active crop progression — both enforced by scripts/check-balance.mjs §production. The tier 6~7 recipes (coconut_bar~crystal_elixir, #297) extend the sink past mango (tier 5) so late-game surplus crops have a consumption path. NOTE: because the net/h ceiling is fixed at the cheapest crop's rate, a recipe's timerMs must be ≳ sellPrice/7200*3600000 = sellPrice*500 — so high-value inputs force very long (multi-week to multi-month) deterministic offline crafts by design; these are ultra-long-horizon sinks for the longest-lived prestige cohort. tier 8+ crops (diamond 43M sell and up) are intentionally NOT used as inputs here because the same ceiling would force multi-year timers (dead content). Add recipes here (key/icon + inputs/timerMs/sellPrice), ascending sellPrice; localized names live in i18n/labels.ts.

cooking.agentPurpose: 요리 도감 시스템(#442): 수확 부산물 재고(production.inventory)를 공유 재료 창고로 사용해, 작물 2~3종을 요리 솥에 넣고 랜덤 추첨으로 150종 메뉴를 발견하는 수집 콘텐츠. 고정 레시피 매칭이 아니라 '재료 조합의 강도(최고 티어·재료 수)'가 추첨 풀과 성공률을 결정한다: successRateByIngredientCount는 재료 수별 성공 확률(2종 90% / 3종 45% — GDD의 초반 쉬움·중후반 30~50% 밴드), grades는 등급별 추첨 가중치와 해금 조건(minMaxTier: 재료 최고 티어 하한, minIngredients: 재료 수 하한)이다. 추첨된 등급 안에서 dish.tier <= 재료 최고 티어인 메뉴가 균등 추첨된다(높은 티어 재료일수록 풀이 넓어져 후반 재료가 의미를 가짐). 실패 시 재료의 failRefundRatio 비율(내림, 저티어 우선)을 환급한다. 조리 타이머는 timerPerTierMs × 재료 최고 티어(결정적)이며 보상형 광고(cookingSpeedAd)로 즉시 완성할 수 있다. 직접적인 골드 보상은 없다: 보상은 도감 완성도 마일스톤(compendiumMilestones)의 영구 전역 판매 보너스이며, 누적 합계는 GDD 리스크 완화 조항에 따라 +10% 이내로 통제한다(check:balance §cooking에서 강제). 등급 분포: common 60 / rare 45 / epic 30 / legendary 15 = 150. 메뉴 현지화 이름은 i18n/labels의 cookingDish에 있다.
